en.arclet.help_create: Choose a named tool, then select a plane or an object. The tool panel shows the next step.
en.arclet.help_edit: Left-click to place or edit. Right-click or Finish completes the current tool. Middle-drag orbits; Shift + middle-drag pans.
en.arclet.help_files: Save the CAD document and node graph separately. In a browser, Save downloads a copy; keep it before closing or reloading.
en.arclet.help_nodes: Nodes is a separate graph document. Connect an output to an input, edit values, and choose Add to model to insert the result.
en.arclet.help_surfaces: Surface contains Loft, Boundary, Blend, Match and Fair. Analyze exposes Zebra, curvature combs and sampled G0–G2 surface seam checks. These are inspection tools, not a Class A certificate.
en.arclet.title: Arclet CAD

en.ui.nodes.title: Nodes
